fields.subject: Notice of Data Breach
fields.intro: Lakeshore Community Bank is writing to tell you about a data security incident that may have involved some of your personal information. We are contacting you directly to explain what happened and the steps you can take to protect yourself.
fields.whatHappened: On October 21, 2026, we detected unusual activity on a file server used by our loan operations team. We immediately disconnected the server and began an investigation with a third-party forensic firm. The investigation found that an unauthorized party copied certain files from the server between October 19 and October 21, 2026.
fields.whatInformation: The files included your name, mailing address, date of birth, Social Security number and loan account number. We have no evidence that your online banking credentials or debit card numbers were involved.
fields.whatWeAreDoing: We removed the unauthorized access, reset credentials across our network, added monitoring on our servers and notified the FBI and our federal banking regulator. We are also offering you 24 months of credit monitoring and identity restoration at no cost to you.
fields.whatYouCanDo: Enroll in the complimentary credit monitoring using the code below. Review your account statements and credit reports, and report anything you do not recognize. You may also place a fraud alert or a security freeze on your credit file at no cost.
fields.forMoreInformation: If you have questions, please call our dedicated assistance line, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Eastern Time, excluding holidays, and have your reference number ready.
